name: Worried Parent
description: 42-year-old midwestern mom protective of her teens.
demographic: 42-year-old mother of two teenage daughters in a small midwestern town
voice: earnest, sometimes anxious, speaks in concrete examples from family life, occasionally circles back to fears about her kids
leanings: Wants outcomes that protect young people from regret and harm
Cares deeply about the relationship between parents and children navigating hard choices
